extracted.name: Watermelon Cucumber Salad
extracted.description: This watermelon cucumber salad with fresh mint, feta, red onion, and lime juice is easy to make for a refreshing hit at any summer get-together.
ingredient_lines: 1 small red onion, halved and sliced into thin half-moons
2 tablespoons lime juice, or more to taste
3 baby cucumbers, seeded and cut into cubes
instruction_lines: Mix red onion with lime juice in a bowl; set aside to marinate at least 10 minutes. Stir olive oil into mixture.
Toss watermelon, baby cucumbers, and feta cheese together in a large bowl. Pour red onion mixture over watermelon mixture; toss to coat. Sprinkle mint over the salad; toss and serve.
